description: 南部科學園區管理局臺南園區滯洪池概況統計 [stormwater and drainage and dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 國家科學及技術委員會南部科學園區管理局. 南部科學園區臺南園區滯洪池概況。 評估園區防洪治水設施量能與水資源管理。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 國家科學及技術委員會南部科學園區管理局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
